theses.thesis: Second-ranked (0.847) and eligible, Big Banks show the highest durability_bar of any top rank (0.71), a trend-classified Hurst tag, strong breadth (0.857), and non-crowded positioning (z=0.44). theses.thesis: Third-ranked (0.41) and eligible with the single best durability_bar in the entire universe (0.77), perfect breadth (1.0), and a trend tag. Non-crowded (z=0.69) and sits in the same Energy complex as the leader, suggesting a coherent energy-leadership structure.
